principles: Data Density over Fluff: Warehouse staff need to see 50 rows, not 5 cards.
Color as Status: Green = Fresh/Paid, Red = Waste/Return, Yellow = Pending.
Input Efficiency: Forms should support keyboard navigation for rapid entry.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-density, data-driven dashboard. Avoid massive empty spaces. Farmers and warehouse staff use this; it must be legible and high-contrast.
instructions_to_main_agent.colors: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use random blues or purples. Stay in the Green/Earth/Grey spectrum.
instructions_to_main_agent.typography: Use 'Manrope' for all Headings (H1-H4). Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for all body text, table data, and inputs. Add these fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
instructions_to_main_agent.tables: Tables are the heart of this app. Make them dense (py-2 or py-3). Use zebra striping for readability. align numbers to the right.
instructions_to_main_agent.forms: Group related fields. Use 'label' clearly. Validation errors must be red and visible.
instructions_to_main_agent.invoice: The invoice generation must result in a clean, printable layout. White background, black text, clear borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.auth: Implement role-based protection. Admin sees everything. Retailers only see their orders/invoices.
instructions_to_main_agent.ocr: For the QC Order OCR page, use a split-view: Image on left (or top on mobile), Extracted Form on right (or bottom).
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
